actors.name: French Presidency of COP21
actors.private_context: The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 negotiation process. They aim to produce a draft agreement text that can be accepted by all parties. They have the authority to circulate draft texts to national delegations.

actors.name: National Delegations
actors.private_context: Each national delegation has its own interests and red lines for the climate agreement. They expect to receive draft texts from the presidency for review and negotiation.

shared_context: COP21 is the 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference held in Paris. The summit is scheduled to conclude on December 11, 2015. The French Presidency is expected to produce and circulate draft agreement texts during the conference. The final scheduled day of the summit is December 11, 2015.

starting_events.description: COP21 officially opens in Paris. The French Presidency begins its role as the presiding body.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the French Presidency circulated at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before 2015-12-11T00:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
